title: command palette performance monitor missing 2 icon after last update
author: Chasapple4
summary: After updating to PowerToys 0.101.2362, two Command Palette Performance Monitor icons are visibly missing, but the affected entries and a usable diagnostic archive are still missing.

judgment.rationale: This may be a 0.101 visual regression, but the current evidence does not identify which two Performance Monitor entries lost icons and the diagnostic archive was rejected, so the fix path cannot be selected confidently.
evidence: The issue includes a screenshot and says two Performance Monitor icons disappeared after updating to 0.101.2362.
The reporter clarified that the version field was transformed and that logs were in the attached archive.
Automated triage reports the archive was rejected due to invalid entry count.
Performance Monitor defines separate glyphs for CPU, memory, disk, read/write, network, GPU, and battery icons in Icons.cs.
Open PR #50231 changes CmdPal IconBox font-icon sizing but is not linked as a confirmed fix for this issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact affected entries and a fresh diagnostic ZIP captured immediately after reproduction.
